name: Kempton Park Racecourse and Sunbury Antiques Market
summary: Kempton Park stages horse racing and other events through the year. The racecourse is also home to the long-running Sunbury Antiques Market, where traders sell furniture, collectibles, art and decorative pieces on selected dates.
reasonToVisit: Horse racing and a long-running antiques market on the same site
planningDetail: Consult the separate racing fixture and antiques market calendars before visiting
